#### Manage your subscription

# Managing The X Subscription

Once you're on The X Subscription, you manage it from [grok.com/dashboard](https://grok.com/dashboard). Your plan, payment details, invoices, and prepaid credit are all on the **Billing & invoices** page at [grok.com/dashboard/billing](https://grok.com/dashboard/billing). On a team, only admins who manage billing can see that page.

Haven't switched yet? See [How to unify accounts under The X Subscription](/x-subscription/unify-accounts).

## Check your plan and renewal date

1. Go to [grok.com/dashboard/billing](https://grok.com/dashboard/billing) to open the **Billing & Invoices dashboard**.
2. Your plan is shown on the **Current plan** card.

## Change your plan

1. On **Billing & invoices**, open the options on the Current plan card and choose to change your plan.
2. Choose a plan, then follow the prompts to confirm.

To learn when a plan change takes effect, see [Upgrade or downgrade a subscription](/x-subscription/upgrade-or-downgrade).

## Cancel your plan

1. On **Billing & invoices**, open the options on the Current plan card and choose to cancel.
2. Follow the prompts to confirm.

## Add or change a payment method

On **Billing & invoices**, go to **Payment details** to add a payment method, change your default, or remove one.

To see which payment methods you can use, see [Which payment methods can I use?](/x-subscription/payment-methods).

## Download an invoice

1. On [Billing & invoices](https://grok.com/dashboard/billing), open the **Invoices** tab.
2. Filter by month or status if you need to, then select the download icon next to the invoice.

Subscription charges and credit top-ups are both listed. For refunds, see [Invoices & Refunds](/x-subscription/invoices-and-refunds).

## Buy prepaid credit (top-up)

1. On [Billing & invoices](https://grok.com/dashboard/billing), find the **Additional usage credits** card
2. Select **Buy credits**, choose an amount, and confirm.

## Turn Auto Top-up on or off

1. Under **Additional usage credits**, select **Set auto top-up**.
2. Choose the balance that triggers a top-up and the amount to add, then save.
3. To stop automatic top-ups, open the same setting and turn it off.

For more, see [Prepaid balance and automatic top-ups](/x-subscription/prepaid-balance).

## Set a spending cap

1. Under **Additional usage credits**, select **Edit** next to **Monthly additional usage limit**.
2. Enter an amount and save it.

For more, see [Spending caps: monthly extra-usage caps and alerts](/x-subscription/spending-caps).

## See your credit grants

If you've received credit grants as part of a promotion, they're listed under **Credit grants** on [Billing & invoices](https://grok.com/dashboard/billing), along with how much of each is left.

## Check your usage

Open **Usage** in the sidebar at [grok.com/dashboard](https://grok.com/dashboard). The **Current plan** card also shows how much of your included usage you've used. For more, see [Usage limits](/x-subscription/usage-limits).

## For Teams admins

* **Add seats**: use the options on the Current plan card.
* **Remove unassigned seats**: use the options on the Current plan card.
* **Invite or manage members:** Open **Members** in the sidebar at [grok.com/dashboard](https://grok.com/dashboard).
* **Cancel the team plan**: use the options on the Current plan card.

For more, see [Team plans: workspaces, seats, and invites](/x-subscription/team-plans).
